PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: The window of the SIRIUS missions, opened from the Missions SIRIUS block: launch or join a mission, leave for its server and come back.
PluginData.Description: Sir Missions Client draws the window of the SIRIUS missions on the Sirius Immersion servers. Use a Missions SIRIUS block (placed by the Sir Missions Companion mod) to open it: it lists the missions offered, with their name, description, maximum of players, duration and reward, and the missions in progress with their places left. Pick the values a mission asks for and launch it, or join a mission in progress without choosing anything. The window then waits for the mission server, with the start time announced; when it is ready your game joins it by its Steam identity alone, by itself if "Leave automatically when it is ready" is checked, otherwise with a click. At the end of the mission your game goes back to the universe you left, where your character waits where you left it. Without this plugin you play as usual: only the block tells you it is needed.
